about_the_game:
Get ready to embark on a cosmic journey like no other in Warpgate Pioneers, a 3D co-op space adventure! Playable in single- or multiplayer! Take command of your own vessel and build it up from a hopeful little cube to a boxy little battle frigate. run freely within your ship, drift freely without it, explore the vast unknown, and team up with friends for an unforgettable journey through the stars.



Key Features:

Spaceship Customization: Use simple building blocks to craft your unique ship by adding and rearranging walls and segments as you explore. From weapon systems to living quarters, the possibilities are endless!

Co-op Gameplay: Dive into the multiplayer experience by captaining your ship, joining the crew of a friend's vessel, or uniting forces to form a powerful fleet. Teamwork is the key to survival in the unforgiving depths of space.

Play Your Way: Make a couple AI holos do all the work and lounge on the viewing deck, or take full control from the pilot's seat. Drift through the cosmos, or conquer the stars.

Dynamic Environments: Enter the Warpgate to discover what strange wonders await. Uncover hidden secrets, encounter alien civilizations, and adapt to the ever-changing cosmic landscape.

Character Customization: Define your look and create your own signature mission badges with the built-in pixelated patch painter!



Join us on this Interstellar Journey
As we continue to develop Warpgate Pioneers, we invite you to be part of our community. Share your feedback, suggestions, and spacefaring tales as we work together to shape the ultimate co-op space adventure!
